tests.description: Unauthenticated call to createComplaint is rejected
Submission on behalf of another student is strictly rejected
Invalid complaint category is rejected with invalid-argument
Attachment exceeding 2MB is rejected by Cloud Function validation
Valid complaint created with atomic ticket ID format (SNK-YYYY-XXXXX)
Authoritative complaint record created with correct status and department SLA
Initial statusHistory record created with status="raised"
Append-only administrative audit log record generated
Idempotent retry returns existing complaint without generating duplicate ticket ID
Public projection /publicComplaints strictly excludes complainant PII and rollNumber
Anonymous complaint projection displays "Anonymous Student" with zero author attribution
Author student CAN upload intake image to own storage path
Student CANNOT upload evidence under another student UID (ownership rule enforced)
Student CANNOT upload to admin resolution evidence path (admin-only rule)
Client CANNOT write directly to /publicComplaints (trusted server-only write)
Client CANNOT write directly to auditLogs (append-only server enforcement)
Student CANNOT mutate ticketId on existing authoritative complaint record
